verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents official client libraries on its integrations page, listing the Python serpapi-python library as "Available". Its own GitHub org also hosts the google-search-results-python package, which has usage examples and per-engine classes (GoogleSearch, BingSearch, BaiduSearch, and others). That package is marked as soon to be deprecated in favor of serpapi-python, so an official supported path exists. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs for languages beyond Python, usage documentation for the newer serpapi-python library itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the library for your language and use your API key to start searching
Alternatively, you can search: Bing using BingSearch class, Baidu using BaiduSearch class, Yahoo using YahooSearch class
We recommend migrating to the newer implementation to ensure continued support and access to the latest features and improvements.
